name: Cable Curl
grip: Supinated overhand grip holding short straight bar attachment, shoulder-width apart.
description: Curl a straight bar attachment attached to a low cable pulley toward the shoulders while standing upright, maintaining constant cable tension throughout the entire elbow flexion arc.
setup: Attach a short straight bar or revolving curl bar to a low cable pulley.
Select the desired weight stack setting.
Stand facing the machine, step back slightly to establish cable tension, and adopt a balanced shoulder-width stance.
Grip the bar with an underhand supinated grip, arms fully extended down in front of your thighs.
instructions: Curl the bar smoothly upward toward your shoulders by flexing your elbows.
Keep your elbows pinned close to your ribcage and upper arms motionless.
Squeeze your biceps firmly at the top peak contraction.
Lower the bar slowly under control, resisting the cable tension until your arms are fully extended at the bottom.
cues: Keep elbows tucked at your sides.
commonMistakes: Drifting elbows forward and upward, using anterior deltoids instead of biceps.
Swinging the torso backward to yank the weight off the stack.
Cutting the bottom range of motion short.

variantNote: Standing bilateral low-cable curl with straight bar attachment. Provides consistent resistance profile across the entire range of motion unlike free weight curls.
